speaker: caller
text: Hello, this is a reminder call from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority about your passport renewal.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh yes, I applied last month.

speaker: caller
text: Your new passport is ready for collection at the ICA Building.

speaker: receiver
text: Great. When can I collect it?

speaker: caller
text: Please book a collection appointment through the MyICA app or the ICA website.

speaker: caller
text: Remember to bring your old passport and your NRIC when you come.

speaker: receiver
text: Do I need to pay anything now?

speaker: caller
text: No, the fee was already paid with your application. ICA will never ask you to transfer money over the phone.

speaker: caller
text: You're welcome. Have a nice day.
